vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: asura
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle is primarily documentation for an AI agent persona. While there are no explicit prompt injection attempts or malicious commands in the `SKILL.md` or other `KRUMP_HISTORY_PART*.md` files, `KRUMP_HISTORY_PART6.md` contains a direct download link to a `.zip` file hosted on Dropbox (`https://www.dropbox.com/s/8w4jvxsgcz608wa/drumkit%20samples.zip`). This external download, if processed by an AI agent with file system access and execution capabilities, presents a significant vulnerability for arbitrary file download and potential code execution, even if the stated purpose is benign (drumkit samples).
